facts.fact: At the border school in his second year, an instructor read Devan's class a seized guild courier's letter whose kindly tone ('a kindness of your own to return') illustrated how masters leash members by mentioning a debt.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires Devan to hear his offer in a guild master's voice, and he has never met one.

facts.fact: Devan once swore on the west stair, the day Asha died, never to be the one who holds a throat; Devan says nothing of this to Neela.
facts.why: needed to ground his horror at making himself her master in his own history.

facts.fact: Neela counts nineteen nights left on the dusk of ch16 and expects the unfed ache to arrive in nine or ten days.
facts.why: needed to track the contract clock and the cost of skipping resin.
